about_short_description.short_description: OddsView is a one-stop shop for sports betting resources and content.

product.name: Arbitrage Tool
product.description: Identifies betting opportunities that guarantee profit regardless of the game's outcome by calculating optimal bet amounts across sportsbooks.

product.name: Positive Expected Value (EV) Tool
product.description: Finds bets with a positive expected value that are mathematically profitable over time, helping users make consistent profits.

product.name: Live Arbitrage Tool
product.description: Provides real-time arbitrage betting opportunities that occur during live games, enabling users to place bets that guarantee profit as odds change.

product.name: Live Expected Value Tool
product.description: Identifies live betting opportunities with positive expected value, often more profitable than pre-match bets, by analyzing real-time odds.

identifier.value: Prematch Odds Screen and Odds Charts

product.name: Prematch Odds Screen and Odds Charts
product.description: Displays historical and current odds movements across sportsbooks for pre-match bets, helping users analyze line changes over time.

product.name: Free Bet Conversion Tool
product.description: Helps users convert sportsbook free bets into cash by finding optimal betting opportunities and calculating bet sizes to maximize returns.
